settings.content: Fonts are served by Shopify (font_face) — pick any font in the Shopify library. The original design used Schibsted Grotesk / Hanken Grotesk, which aren't in Shopify's library; defaults below are the closest grotesk substitutes.

The word "Enrolment" is being removed from pack names, so this colour block is the only thing telling a customer whether they are looking at an enrolment pack or a reorder pack. Treat it as meaning, not decoration. THE COLOURS BELOW ARE PLACEHOLDERS PENDING CLIENT CONFIRMATION (ClickUp 869etbgcb) — change them here, no code change needed.

A product's pack type is read from its ava.pack_type metafield first. These comma-separated collection handles are only a fallback for products whose metafield is not set yet, and can be emptied once every pack carries the metafield.

settings.label: Enrolment collection handles
settings.info: The live collection handle is misspelled 'enrollement'; both spellings are listed so it keeps working if that is corrected.

settings.label: Reorder collection handles
settings.info: Deliberately empty by default. 'wholesale' also contains the single Balance / Balance+ / Renew+ products, so using it here would tint those too. Populate the ava.pack_type metafield instead, or list handles here only if they contain reorder packs exclusively.

settings.label: Storefront API public access token
settings.info: Public access token from a custom app (Settings > Apps and sales channels > Develop apps > your app > API credentials). Used to sync cart attributes into a cart metafield via cartMetafieldsSet. Leave blank to disable.
